title: The dev shell: Ctrl+\ puts a dark frame around the site for tools

chat.text: Press Ctrl+\ anywhere and a dark shell wraps the site: a header, the page tree on the left, the dev tabs on the right, a footer. The page itself stays in the middle and keeps working. Press it again and it's gone; nothing is torn down, it just hides. It's built from core/Shell (the grid and the resizable sides) and reuses the dev bar's own tabs, so a tab added there appears here too. Docs: /framework/dev/DevShell/. Being polished next (queued): tab bars that stay put while only the tab body scrolls, the resize handles, and the one shared chat with Dictate in its tab.
